expectation_details.expectation: When the user asked when the next race is, the agent answered with the race details in that same turn, instead of only saying it would check or connect them and waiting for the user to speak again.
expectation_details.justification: The agent provided the specific race name (Bahrain Grand Prix), location, and dates immediately upon the user's initial inquiry about the next race.

expectation_details.expectation: The agent gave session times converted to Tokyo / Japan time (JST) at some point, without asking the user for their location again, since the user already said they watch from Tokyo.
expectation_details.justification: The agent correctly identified the user's location as Tokyo and provided the session times in JST, without requiring the user to restate their location.

expectation_details.expectation: The agent reported the status of order 1002 and made clear that the order lookup is a mock / simulated demo.
expectation_details.justification: The agent provided the order status ('In Transit'), carrier information, and explicitly stated, 'In our simulated mock demo system... this order data is mocked and simulated for demonstration purposes only.'

expectation_details.expectation: In the final turn, the agent gave the qualifying time in Tokyo / Japan time (JST) without asking again where the user is, remembering the Tokyo detail from the start of the conversation.
expectation_details.justification: The agent successfully recalled the user's location (Tokyo) and provided the qualifying time (Saturday, 5 PM) in that local time context without re-prompting for the user's location.
